maria (runtime): hey all — starting a thread to align on the telemetry contract for continuous-batching metrics. we need runtime+infra+platform inputs for dashboards and alerts. quick list proposal below, please react with :+1: or ⚠️ and add extras.

kevin (platform): high-level ok. can you list what cardinality you expect and what tags (model, region, device_type, priority)? cardinality will drive prometheus cost.

maria (runtime): yes — minimal tags: model_name, deployment_id, region, gpu_type, priority_class. avoid request_id-level tags. expected cardinality ~ 100s of time series per cluster.

chris (infra): noted. need to cap label values for gpu_type and model_name length. also prefer hashed model_id for dashboards to avoid huge label sets.

sophia (console): from console side we want these top-level metrics: p50/p95 queue_wait_ms, p50/p95 batch_size, batch_size_histogram, queue_depth, per-device saturation (GPU_utilization_buckets), and a derived "backpressure" boolean. dashboards will slice by model, region.

maria (runtime): propose metric names and rough prometheus queries (for platform/infra to vet):
```
# produced by runtime
batch_size_bucket{model="...",deployment="...",le="10"}  # histogram
batch_wait_seconds{model="...",deployment="..."}  # summary or histogram
batch_emit_rate_total{deployment="..."}  # counter
queue_depth{deployment="...",priority="..."}  # gauge
device_saturation_ratio{device="...",region="..."}  # gauge 0-1
```
and example queries:
```
# p95 batch wait
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(batch_wait_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, model, deployment))
# median batch size
histogram_quantile(0.5, sum(rate(batch_size_bucket[5m])) by (le, model, deployment))
# saturation alert if >0.9 for 2m
avg_over_time(device_saturation_ratio[2m]) > 0.9
```

kevin (platform): those look fine. two platform concerns: 1) we want a single "batching_health" rollup metric for the console (enum OK/WARN/CRITICAL) to avoid users having to reason about many widgets; 2) avoid high-cardinality joins in dashboards. propose we emit rollup on runtime side aggregated by deployment.

maria (runtime): can do rollup metric. suggestion: `batching_health{deployment,model,region} "OK|WARN|CRITICAL"` — but prometheus can't store strings. we should emit numeric codes: 0=OK,1=WARN,2=CRITICAL and document mapping.

chris (infra): agree numeric code is best. infra will also provide `node_queue_capacity` and `gpu_free_slots` gauges so console can compute saturation across hosts. those will be labeled by node and pool.

sophia (console): UX ask — make sure deployments expose a human-friendly display name or tag so consoles show product names (not internal hashed ids). we can accept hashed_id for queries but need a mapping endpoint for lookup.

elena (product): from product: add an annotation/owner on each deployment metric so on-call knows who to ping. maybe a tag `owner_team`.

maria (runtime): we'll add `owner_team` label but keep it low-cardinality (team names only).

kevin (platform): alerting proposals:
- Saturation alert: avg device_saturation_ratio by pool > 0.9 for 5m => warn, 15m => critical
- Long wait alert: p95(batch_wait_seconds) by deployment > 200ms for 5m => warn
- Tiny batches alert: median(batch_size) by model < 2 for 10m => warn (indicates maybe routing broken or low QPS)

chris (infra): infra will enforce max label cardinality and will drop any label with >1000 unique values per metric. we'll also provide a telemetry-agent that scrubs model_name to hashed_model when needed.

maria (runtime): action items I can pick: 1) RFC for metric names + label set (maria) 2) runtime PR to emit metrics + rollup (maria) 3) infra telemetry-agent changes (chris) 4) console dashboard templates + mapping endpoint (sophia) 5) alert rules draft (kevin)

sophia (console): timeline? if we get RFC this week we can build dashboard v1 next sprint.

maria (runtime): aim: RFC by Thu (1745200000), runtime PR in two weeks, dashboards in next sprint.

elena (product): good. also flagging SLA implication: need owners for critical alerts.

kevin (platform): I'll draft alert runbook snippets and escalation paths.

maria (runtime): small technical note: continuous batching uses short-lived queues per deployment+priority; for queue_depth metric we should export both `queue_depth_current` (gauge) and `queue_depth_max_allocated` so we can compute saturation.

chris (infra): infra will add `pool_capacity` and expose `preemptible_slots` too.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: runtime/telemetry agent v0.9 -> prod canary in 30m :rocket:

maria (runtime): thanks — next step: I'll post RFC link here once drafted, please comment specifically on label sets and queries. tagging owners: @kevin (platform) @chris (infra) @sophia (console).

kevin (platform): ack. will review.

sophia (console): ack — will mock dashboard tiles with placeholder metrics.

chris (infra): ack — will check label limits and telemetry-agent changes.

elena (product): ack — will add owner list to RFC.

maria (runtime): thanks everyone :sparkles:
